text:
62세 여성 환자, acute decompensated heart failure로 입원, dilated cardiomyopathy 기인함.

BP 95/60 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 24 breaths/min, BT 36.8°C, SpO2 90% on room air 확인됨.

Shortness of breath severe.

Furosemide 40 mg IV q8h 적용함.

4 L/min via nasal cannula 산소공급 유지함.

Foley 유지함.

IO: Negative balance of 500 mL over 24 hours.

Clinical status: drowsy 확인됨.

Cardiology team notify함 for persistent hypotension.
